questions.q: Where did Mr. Jeremy Fisher live?
choices: In a little damp house at the edge of a pond
In a hollow log beside a deep river
In a tidy hole under a big fir-tree
In a round green boat on the lake
questions.evidence: he lived in a little damp house amongst the buttercups at the edge of a pond

questions.q: What did Mr. Jeremy want to catch for his dinner?
choices: A big trout
A dish of minnows
Some water-beetles
A fat stickleback

questions.q: What was Mr. Jeremy's boat like?

Round and green, like a lily-leaf
Small and white, made of paper
Flat and yellow, like a buttercup

Jack Sharp the stickleback
